Residential•Pali Hill, Mumbai•2024

The Pali Residence

A 3,200 sq ft family residence in the heart of Pali Hill, reimagined as a calm, layered interior that balances warmth with restraint. Every material was chosen for its tactile quality and its ability to age gracefully.

View Case Study
Residential•Worli, Mumbai•2024

Altitude Penthouse

A sky-level penthouse with panoramic sea views required a design language that would not compete with the horizon. We chose restraint — deep tones, natural stone, and a palette that recedes to let the city speak.

Commercial•Bandra West, Mumbai•2023

Chapter One Café

A neighbourhood café designed around the rituals of reading and slow mornings. The brief was for a space that felt like it had always been there — worn-in, comfortable, full of character.

View Case Study
Hospitality•Alibaug, Maharashtra•2023

The Sea Villa

A private coastal retreat designed to dissolve the boundary between interior and landscape. The villa is meant to be lived in loosely — with bare feet, salt air, and morning light.

View Case Study
Commercial•BKC, Mumbai•2022

Merit Office Campus

A contemporary workplace designed around the idea that the best offices feel like great homes — calm, considered, and full of natural materials. The brief was to move away from the open-plan monotony common to tech companies.
